decisions.reason: As a complementary accessory built on the core offer, it is relatively cheap to keep available and preserves upside from the installed base and future machine sales.

Because it is distant from the established offer, uncertainty should be largely resolved by now and the firm is likely to reallocate resources to stronger core options if traction has not clearly materialized.
A high-speed CNC milling machine line is close to the firm's core capabilities and strategy, so the option has likely moved from experiment to selective commitment rather than abandonment.
This automation add-on fits the firm's modular engineering and productivity-focused value proposition, making it a useful low-risk complement to the main equipment business.
